title: Finiteness of planar five-body central configurations for generic equal-pair masses
description:
Manuscript, exact verification code, and certificates for finiteness of planar five-body central configurations with generic positive equal-pair masses (a,a,b,b,c). The theorem concerns masses outside a proper algebraic hypersurface; it does not determine the complete exceptional polynomial or count configurations.

The verification package and commands are documented in the README. Code is MIT-licensed; the manuscript is CC BY 4.0.
